titleEn: Page-builder AI v2: knows products, brand, look; adds blocks, links products, fixes mobile, creates pages
api: (planned) engine tools over the builder document + catalogue

ar: حط المنتجات الجديدة في القسم ده
en: Build me a landing page for my new collection

steps: Editor > Ask AI. It adds, moves and removes blocks, points sections at your products, categories, images and links, and fixes the phone view as a preview you apply to the draft. Creating whole new pages is not available yet.
edgeCases: Preview must show one combined plan
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Team member lacking the permission gets 403: assistant states who can do it (store owner) instead of retrying
gaps: Create pages from a request not built; new block cannot be filled in the same request (the model does not know its id yet)
